objectives.en: Say every fact from three times one to three times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti three times one dé three times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from three times one reach three times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any three times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí three times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any three times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.objective: Multiply whole numbers 1 x 1 up to 9 x 9, using a 10 by 10 square chart
curriculum.note: No scheme subdivides the 1x1 to 9x9 block by table; only the term is supported.

say.en: Look at three groups of three mangoes. Today we count in threes.
say.pcm: Look three groups of three mango. Today we go count three three.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti three mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní three three.

say.en: Today you will learn the three times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table three. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table three. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the two times table? What is two times three?
say.pcm: You remember table two? Two times three na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table two? Kí ni two times three?

say.en: Three groups of three mangoes show this. We count three, six, nine. Three times three is nine.
say.pcm: See three groups of three mango: three, six, nine. Three times three na nine.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti three mango: three, six, nine. Three times three jẹ́ nine.

say.en: Say it with me: three times three is nine.
say.pcm: Say am with me: three times three na nine.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: three times three jẹ́ nine.

say.en: Say the three times table. Start with three times one. End with three times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table three. Start with three times one. End with three times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table three. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú three times one. Parí pẹ̀lú three times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Three times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the three times table once more. Then we start the four times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table three again. Then we start table four.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table three. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table four.
